descriptionStructure: Category and brand appropriate emotional opening
Useful product details and original size tables
Styling or usage only when supported; an identity close when it adds meaning
namingRules: Use evocative, descriptive-poetic and identity-led registers.
Keep the source-backed product noun and preserve authored names.
Check naming identities against the live catalog before publication.
Use The deliberately, without adding it to every title.
Do not invent ingredients, materials, manufacture, fit, scent notes, wear time or benefits.
languageRules: Warm and confident, without pressure, shame or empty empowerment slogans.
Specificity before adjective stacks; every word earns its place.
Use factual bullets for ingredients, sizing and care when useful.
Confidence phrases belong in hooks and CTAs, not repeated product-body boilerplate.
Business tiers and inspiration-brand persona labels are internal.
Category hooks are editorial framing, never evidence of a physical effect.

channels.product: Lead with feeling, then identify the product and preserve useful verified facts.
channels.seo: Use the real product category and verified attributes. Avoid keyword stuffing and unsupported ethical, ownership or efficacy claims.
channels.email: Personal, warm and intentional; one clear action per execution.
channels.sms: Brief and human; one clear action and truthful availability.
channels.social: Adapt rhythm to the platform while keeping each brand distinct. Trend exceptions are for deliberate Princess captions, not automated product copy.
channels.ads: Specific desire with truthful product evidence; no invented urgency, reviews or social proof.
channels.blog: Useful, deeper storytelling with verified facts and consistent brand language.
channels.service: Warm and clear. Preserve operational facts such as dates, quantities and delivery information.
channels.faq: Answer the actual question warmly and clearly. Use current product details; link current shipping and returns terms without inventing promises.
channels.collection: Use a stable brand and category introduction; express personal choice without implying every product shares an unverified feature.
channels.cta: One warm invitation in the routed brand voice; no manufactured urgency.

referenceOnly: Unverified business labels and social proof
